import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,d,e,w,ph,g,h,q = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    return a*P + b*P**2 + (c + d*t + e*np.sin(w*t+ph))*P**(-q) + g*t + h
